title: Priorities chat and written top-3 list
text: Hold a ten-minute priorities chat at the start of each week and give each new hire a written list of their top three tasks.

notes.en: Your team lead now agrees your top three tasks with you at the start of each week.
notes.ms: Ketua pasukan anda kini menetapkan tiga tugas utama bersama anda pada awal setiap minggu.
notes.zh: 你的组长现在每周一开始时会和你一起确定三项最重要的任务。

title: Written role checklist
text: Give each new hire a one-page list of their main tasks and who to ask, and walk through it together in the first week.

notes.en: You now get a one-page list of your main tasks and who to ask, and your team lead goes through it with you.
notes.ms: Anda kini menerima senarai satu muka surat tugas utama dan orang untuk ditanya, dan ketua pasukan akan menerangkannya bersama anda.
notes.zh: 你现在会收到一页主要任务清单和可以请教的人，组长会和你一起过一遍。

title: Short weekly one-to-one
text: Book a fifteen-minute one-to-one each week for the first three months, with one question: what is blocking you?

notes.en: Your team lead now books a short one-to-one with you every week.
notes.ms: Ketua pasukan anda kini mengadakan perjumpaan empat mata yang singkat dengan anda setiap minggu.
notes.zh: 你的组长现在每周都会和你进行一次简短的一对一谈话。

title: Named buddy
text: Name an experienced colleague as the buddy for every new hire's first month, for everyday questions.

notes.en: Every new hire now has a named buddy for everyday questions in the first month.
notes.ms: Setiap pekerja baharu kini ada rakan bimbingan untuk soalan harian pada bulan pertama.
notes.zh: 每位新员工在第一个月都有一位指定的伙伴，可以随时请教日常问题。

title: Team lunch
text: Invite the new hire to eat with the team in the first two weeks and introduce them to each person by name.

notes.en: Your team now invites new hires to lunch in the first two weeks and introduces everyone by name.
notes.ms: Pasukan anda kini menjemput pekerja baharu makan tengah hari dalam dua minggu pertama dan memperkenalkan semua orang.
notes.zh: 你的团队现在会在头两周邀请新员工一起吃午饭，并介绍每位同事。

title: Welcome round
text: On the first day, introduce the new hire to the whole team and share one thing each person can help with.

notes.en: On the first day, the whole team now says hello and shares one thing each person can help with.
notes.ms: Pada hari pertama, seluruh pasukan kini memperkenalkan diri dan berkongsi satu perkara yang boleh dibantu oleh setiap orang.
notes.zh: 现在第一天全组同事都会打招呼，并说明每人可以帮忙的一件事。

title: Training checklist
text: Make a checklist of the machines, systems and safety steps each new hire must be shown, and tick each one off with them.

notes.en: You now get a checklist of the systems and steps you must be shown, and each one is ticked off with you.
notes.ms: Anda kini menerima senarai semak sistem dan langkah yang perlu ditunjukkan, dan setiap satu ditanda bersama anda.
notes.zh: 你现在会收到一份需要学习的系统和步骤清单，每一项都会和你一起确认完成。

title: Shadow then do
text: Pair the new hire with a trainer for each new task: watch once, do once with help, then do alone.

notes.en: For each new task, you now watch once, do it once with help, then do it alone.
notes.ms: Untuk setiap tugas baharu, anda kini memerhati sekali, buat sekali dengan bantuan, kemudian buat sendiri.
notes.zh: 每项新任务，你现在会先看一次，在帮助下做一次，然后再独立完成。

title: Workload check
text: Review the new hire's task list and hours together every two weeks, and move or drop work that does not fit.

notes.en: Your team lead now reviews your tasks and hours with you every two weeks and moves work that does not fit.
notes.ms: Ketua pasukan anda kini menyemak tugas dan waktu kerja anda setiap dua minggu dan mengalihkan kerja yang tidak sesuai.
notes.zh: 你的组长现在每两周和你一起检查任务和工时，并调整不合适的工作。

title: Overtime limit
text: Agree a limit on overtime for new hires in the first three months and check it each week.

notes.en: There is now a limit on overtime for new hires in the first three months, checked each week.
notes.ms: Kini ada had kerja lebih masa untuk pekerja baharu dalam tiga bulan pertama, disemak setiap minggu.
notes.zh: 现在新员工在头三个月的加班有上限，并且每周检查。

title: Update the job ad and the interview script for this role
text: Compare the job ad and the interview script with the real work on the line, rewrite what oversells the job, and agree the changes with the recruiter.
